subject: Next steps to accelerate POC — leadership onramp + technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@retailwave.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Oct 2029 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps to accelerate POC — leadership onramp + technical deep dive

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — really useful to understand RetailWave's Q4 priorities and the constraints on latency and data residency. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost per transaction for recommendation scoring while meeting 99th percentile latency <= 75ms for online lookup.
- Data concerns: EU customer dataset must remain in-region for compliance (haven't confirmed whether HIPAA applies yet).
- Throughput: expected 2k QPS peak across region; initial pilot target ~200 QPS sustained.

To keep momentum I suggest a single 45–60 minute session that combines: 1) a short exec alignment (VP/CTO handshake) to confirm success criteria and decision owners, and 2) a technical deep dive with our solutions engineer to validate integration approach and runbook. Proposed slots (all in UTC):

- Tue 2029-10-18 16:00–17:00 (ideal for our Eng/SE team)
- Wed 2029-10-19 14:00–15:00 (backup)

If those don't work, feel free to propose two 30–45m windows that fit your leadership and Carlos' calendar. Agenda we plan to cover: 1) success metrics & SLA targets, 2) data residency and compliance constraints, 3) integration approach (batch vs streaming vs cache), 4) pilot runbook and next milestones.

Attachments: I attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) with proposed milestones and stakeholders. We can update that during the call.

Next steps: can you confirm which slot Carlos (or the CTO) prefers and whether you'd like the session recorded / shared notes after?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this locked.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@retailwave.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Medina <c.medina@retailwave.io>
Date: Sat, 12 Oct 2029 09:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps to accelerate POC — leadership onramp + technical deep dive

Marcus —

Appreciate the concise recap. That aligns well with what we discussed. Quick answers/notes before we lock a time:

- Carlos (VP Eng) will need to be on the call; I looped him in. He'll want to hear how you plan to keep the EU dataset within our region and what the fallback plan is if latency spikes.
- HIPAA isn't applicable to this workload but we do have stricter regional retention policies for EU customers.
- We can aim for the Tue 10/18 slot, but Carlos has a conflict from 16:15–17:00 UTC. Would you be able to shift slightly earlier (15:30–16:15) or split into two shorter segments (15:30–15:55 exec + 16:05–16:40 tech)?

Agenda request from our side: please include an estimated cost delta for the pilot (per 1k QPS) and a short list of integration touchpoints (API, S3 ingestion, auth method). Also, can you send a short one-pager for Carlos to review before the call?

If you can do 15:30–16:15 UTC on Tue we'll lock it. Otherwise Wed 14:00–15:00 would work but prefer Tue if possible.

Thanks —
Alyssa Turner
Head of Data & Product Partnerships | RetailWave
alyssa.turner@retailwave.io | +1 (646) 555-0198

Marissa / Priyom —

Forwarding Alyssa's reply. RetailWave confirmed interest and their VP Eng (Carlos Medina) must be present; they asked to shift the joint session to 15:30–16:15 UTC on Tue 2029-10-18 if we can accommodate.

Can we do the following?

- Priyom: be prepared to run a 20–25m technical deep dive focused on data residency, integration (API vs S3), and the caching strategy. Quick cost estimate per 1k QPS would be great to show live.
- Marissa: I'd like you to join the first 15 minutes for exec alignment (success criteria and decision timeline) and to cover commercial cadence. If we can confirm the slot, I'll send the invite to RetailWave and attach the MAP.

I've attached the MAP and a draft runbook. If either of you sees major gaps, flag them and I'll update before I send to RetailWave.

Thanks — Marcus
